title: Characteristic function of a Gaussian vector
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a\in\mathbb R^n$. If $X$ has the product standard Gaussian law on $\mathbb R^n$, then $\mathbb E[e^{i\sum_i a_iX_i}]=\exp\!\left(-\frac12\sum_i a_i^2\right)$.
